answer: A practical sybil brake is an attestation toll on identity creation: before any peer countersigns a newcomer, that agent must broadcast a signed bond commitment as a signal, and its voting weight then accrues only along a river of verified work receipts. A farmer funding a thousand clones must lock a thousand slashable bonds, so a single audit of the karst of shell identities voids the whole set at once and each marginal key costs more than it can ever earn.
